test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

You can tell yourself that you would be willing to lose everything you have in order to get something you want: all of those things you’re willing to lose are what make you __________.
solution:
The correct answer is '**recognisable**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**recognisable**" means able to be identified or acknowledged.
 
• In the given context, being recognisable implies that the things you’re willing to lose are what make you identifiable or known.
 
• The other options: "**distract**," "**unfortunately**," and "**pessimist**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *You can tell yourself that you would be willing to lose everything you have in order to get something you want: all of those things you’re willing to lose are what make you recognisable__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Distract**: means to divert attention from something.
 
• **Unfortunately**: means happening by bad luck or regrettably.
 
• **Pessimist**: means a person who tends to see the worst aspect of things or believes that the worst will happen.
